figs.name: half-adder-vs-full-adder-two-half-adders-circuit-diagram
figs.alt: full adder made from two half adders and one OR gate block diagram
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a full adder built from two half adders: the first adds A and B, the second adds Cin, and an OR gate joins both carries.
figs.after_h2: Building a Full Adder From Two Half Adders
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Full adder built from two half adders and an OR gate</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Full Adder From Two Half Adders</text>
<rect x="170" y="90" width="170" height="150" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="255" y="125" font-size="18" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Half adder 1</text>
<text x="255" y="160" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">S1 = A XOR B</text>
<text x="255" y="190" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">C1 = A AND B</text>
<rect x="430" y="170" width="170" height="150" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="515" y="205" font-size="18" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Half adder 2</text>
<text x="515" y="240" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">S = S1 XOR Cin</text>
<text x="515" y="270" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">C2 = S1 AND Cin</text>
<path d="M560 380 Q600 380 640 405 Q600 430 560 430 Q575 405 560 380 Z" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="600" y="412" font-size="17" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">OR</text>
<line x1="60" y1="130" x2="170" y2="130" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="50" y="136" font-size="20" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">A</text>
<line x1="60" y1="200" x2="170" y2="200" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="50" y="206" font-size="20" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">B</text>
<line x1="60" y1="290" x2="430" y2="290" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="50" y="296" font-size="20" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Cin</text>
<polyline points="340,130 385,130 385,210 430,210" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="362" y="120" font-size="17" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">S1</text>
<path d="M340 210 H365 V280 A10 10 0 0 1 365 300 V420 H566" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="395" y="412" font-size="17" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">C1</text>
<polyline points="600,290 615,290 615,345 520,345 520,390 566,390" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="500" y="372" font-size="17" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">C2</text>
<line x1="600" y1="210" x2="720" y2="210" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="730" y="216" font-size="20" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Sum</text>
<line x1="640" y1="405" x2="720" y2="405" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="730" y="411" font-size="20" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Cout</text>
<text x="400" y="475" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Cout = C1 OR C2, total gates: 2 XOR, 2 AND, 1 OR</text>
</svg>

figs.name: half-adder-vs-full-adder-worked-example-flowchart
figs.alt: full adder worked example flowchart with A 1, B 0 and carry in 1
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog working through the full adder example A equals 1, B equals 0, Cin equals 1, giving Sum 0 and Cout 1 through two half adders.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Full adder worked example A equals 1, B equals 0, Cin equals 1 step by step</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Full Adder Worked Example: A=1, B=0, Cin=1</text>
<rect x="60" y="70" width="680" height="110" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="105" cy="125.0" r="30" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="105" y="132.0" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="155" y="102" font-size="19" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">First half adder</text>
<text x="155" y="132" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">S1 = 1 XOR 0 = 1</text>
<text x="155" y="160" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">C1 = 1 AND 0 = 0</text>
<line x1="400" y1="182" x2="400" y2="206" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="210" width="680" height="110" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="105" cy="265.0" r="30" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="105" y="272.0" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="155" y="242" font-size="19" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Second half adder</text>
<text x="155" y="272" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Sum = S1 XOR Cin = 1 XOR 1 = 0</text>
<text x="155" y="300" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">C2 = S1 AND Cin = 1 AND 1 = 1</text>
<line x1="400" y1="322" x2="400" y2="346" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="350" width="680" height="84" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="105" cy="392.0" r="30" fill="#dc2626" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="105" y="399.0" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="155" y="382" font-size="19" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">OR gate</text>
<text x="155" y="412" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Cout = C1 OR C2 = 0 OR 1 = 1</text>
<rect x="60" y="464" width="680" height="92" rx="12" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="21" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Result: Sum = 0, Cout = 1</text>
<text x="400" y="534" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Check: Cout = AB + BCin + ACin = 0 + 0 + 1 = 1</text>
</svg>
